name: When the Night Comes
source:
You are a renowned Hunter, a creature slayer who has been called to the quiet, strange little town of Lunaris to assist the local Enforcers with an investigation into a series of unsettling and unexplained supernatural murders.

Immerse yourself in the world of witches, vampires, demons and lycans as you slowly unravel the dark mystery that lies deep within the roots of the town.

The question is, are the creatures of the night the ones you should really be afraid of? 

You might even fall in forbidden love along the way.

[From [url=https://lunarisgames.itch.io/wtnc]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一名声名卓著的猎人，专门猎杀生物；如今受召来到安静而古怪的小镇月神镇，协助当地执法者调查一系列令人不安、无法解释的超自然谋杀案。

沉浸在女巫、吸血鬼、恶魔与狼人组成的世界中，逐渐揭开深埋于小镇根源的黑暗谜团。

问题是，你真正应该害怕的，真的是夜间生物吗？

在旅途中，你甚至可能坠入禁忌之恋。

[来源：[url=https://lunarisgames.itch.io/wtnc]itch.io[/url]]
